newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - BPI now a buy - Paribas Asia.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BPI now a buy - Paribas Asia.

text.p: The Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) has been upgraded to a buy amid the current foreign exchange volatility, Paribas Asia Equity said.
"The BPI has just entered our core buy list, thanks to volatility in the currency which brought its valuation to a more attractive level," a Paribas Asia Equity study released on Friday said.
BPI has been one of the stocks hammered in recent months following the speculative attack on the peso.
Analysts Ed Bancod and Mike Bengson said investors should not worry about its foreign exchange liabilities.
"Dollar loans are equivalent to only 10 percent of its loan book. This compares well with an industry average of 30 percent," the two said in the report.
They added fears of widespread loan defaults were unfounded. "Any increase in non-performing loans must surely be covered by its huge reserves."
BPI gained nine pesos on Friday to close at 162 pesos.
